title: TipTap Editor Extensions — Table, Math, Callout
description: Install 6 npm dependencies and create TipTap editor extensions for tables, inline/block math (KaTeX), and callout blocks. Register all extensions in NikoEditor and add slash commands to the menu.
action: Install docx, katex, @tiptap/extension-table, @tiptap/extension-table-row, @tiptap/extension-table-cell, @tiptap/extension-table-header. Create MathInline.ts (inline node with KaTeX lazy render), MathBlock.ts (block node with KaTeX lazy render), Callout.ts (node with data-variant for info/warning/tip/important). Configure Table extension with community packages. Register all 5 new extensions (Table, TableRow, TableCell, TableHeader, MathInline, MathBlock, Callout) in NikoEditor.tsx extensions array. Add 4 slash command entries (table, math, math-block, callout) to SlashCommandMenu.tsx items array.

steps: Create src/components/editor/extensions/MathInline.ts — TipTap Node extension, inline: true, atom: true, addAttributes: { latex: { default: '' } }, addNodeView: lazy-load katex and renderToHTML

Create src/components/editor/extensions/MathBlock.ts — TipTap Node extension, inline: false, atom: true, group: 'block', addAttributes: { latex: { default: '' } }, addNodeView: lazy-load katex and renderToHTML
Create src/components/editor/extensions/Callout.ts — TipTap Node extension, group: 'block', content: 'block+', addAttributes: { variant: { default: 'info' } }, renderHTML with data-variant attribute
Add CSS styles for callout variants (info=blue, warning=yellow, tip=green, important=red) using data-variant selector
Modify NikoEditor.tsx — import and add Table, TableRow, TableCell, TableHeader, MathInline, MathBlock, Callout to useEditor extensions array

Modify SlashCommandMenu.tsx — add 4 entries to items: { id: 'table', label: '表格', description: '插入表格', icon: TableIcon, type: 'format' }, { id: 'math', label: '行内公式', icon: SigmaIcon, type: 'format' }, { id: 'math-block', label: '块级公式', icon: FunctionIcon, type: 'format' }, { id: 'callout', label: '提示块', icon: AlertCircleIcon, type: 'format' }
Add slash command handlers in NikoEditor.tsx handleSlashSelect — insertTable, insertContent for math nodes, insertContent for callout

criteria: grep -r 'Table' src/components/NikoEditor.tsx — Table extension registered in extensions array
grep -r 'MathInline\|MathBlock\|Callout' src/components/NikoEditor.tsx — all new extensions registered
